mc275eb081326.en: Remove downloaded AMBER installers. They can be downloaded again; game content is unaffected.

mac5969fa5d1e.zh: 删除升级前保留的配置副本，可能包含加密的历史账号库。不会删除实例备份或游戏存档。
mac5969fa5d1e.en: Remove pre-upgrade configuration copies, which may include encrypted historical accounts. Instance backups and worlds are kept.

mb2b8b67d7ead.en: Graphics preference saved. It will apply on the next game launch.

m50f6ada3c910.zh: 已恢复 AMBER 修改的显卡偏好；你在系统中另作的修改会保留。
m50f6ada3c910.en: Graphics preferences changed by AMBER have been restored. Separate changes made in Windows are preserved.

mda767666bc6b.zh: 此项为全局偏好，作用于游戏使用的 Java。共用 Java 的实例会共用这项系统设置。
mda767666bc6b.en: This global preference applies to the game’s Java runtime. Instances sharing Java also share this Windows setting.

m61ab59155d9e.zh: Windows 和驱动最终决定使用哪张显卡。修改后需重新启动游戏；不会改变正在运行的游戏。
m61ab59155d9e.en: Windows and the driver determine the GPU used. Restart the game after changes; running games are not changed.

ma4b9bd208e83.zh: 当前系统不支持自动应用显卡偏好，请使用系统图形设置。
ma4b9bd208e83.en: Automatic graphics preferences are unavailable on this system. Use Windows graphics settings.

mb63ae9b47761.zh: 恢复 AMBER 修改的显卡偏好
mb63ae9b47761.en: Restore graphics preferences changed by AMBER

m34320c0f00dd.en: Not detected. Identified from logs after launch.

m4502309f2d35.zh: 偏好已应用，实际显卡以游戏为准。
m4502309f2d35.en: Preference applied; the game’s actual renderer may differ.

mc2593a864059.zh: 自动应用未完成，可打开 Windows 图形设置。
mc2593a864059.en: Could not apply automatically. Open Windows graphics settings.

m2152aea59d2a.en: The setting was changed externally. AMBER preserved that setting.

maaf0b191c213.en: Cannot read or apply Windows graphics preferences. Open Windows graphics settings.

m9a32525a29ce.zh: 显卡偏好恢复记录无法读取，请打开系统图形设置。
m9a32525a29ce.en: Cannot read the graphics recovery record. Open Windows graphics settings.

m4adb99f64b03.zh: 显卡偏好记录已满，请先恢复系统设置。
m4adb99f64b03.en: The graphics recovery record is full. Restore Windows preferences first.

mb67bffdf84db.zh: AmberE 保留离线和第三方账号，不提供微软登录；与 AMBER 共用功能核心。
mb67bffdf84db.en: AmberE supports offline and third-party accounts without Microsoft sign-in, sharing the AMBER feature core.

mb4db02c2b7ed.zh: AmberE 支持离线和第三方账号，不提供微软登录。离线账号不授予游戏所有权。
mb4db02c2b7ed.en: AmberE supports offline and third-party accounts without Microsoft sign-in. Offline accounts do not grant ownership of the game.

m80c91e27ae85.zh: 账号令牌由当前 Windows 用户的系统加密保护。第三方账号密码只发送至你填写的认证地址，不会保存。
m80c91e27ae85.en: Account tokens are protected by the current Windows user’s system encryption. Third-party passwords are sent only to your authentication address and are not saved.

m54ea6217699a.zh: 玩家名称需要 3–16 位英文字母、数字或下划线。
m54ea6217699a.en: Player names must contain 3–16 English letters, digits or underscores.

m6e9c2fc77dc9.zh: 完整游戏需要有效正版资格；离线身份保留原正版角色，资格最多缓存 7 天。
m6e9c2fc77dc9.en: The full game requires verified ownership. Offline identities retain your official profile; verification is cached for up to 7 days.

me207722e755e.zh: AMBER 需要验证 Minecraft Java 版正版资格。可先管理实例，登录与验证在账号页完成。
me207722e755e.en: AMBER requires verified Minecraft Java Edition ownership. You can manage instances first, then sign in and verify on the Accounts page.

mb7c1716bbd11.zh: AMBER 将游戏资格与服务器身份分别验证。完整游戏启动前必须有有效正版资格。
mb7c1716bbd11.en: AMBER verifies game ownership separately from server identity. Valid ownership is required before launching the full game.

m610db7a2798e.zh: 微软与第三方账号启动时在线验证资格；已验证离线身份保留原角色，最多使用 7 天。到期后需要联网重新验证。
m610db7a2798e.en: Microsoft and third-party launches verify ownership online. Verified offline identities retain your original profile for up to 7 days, then require online verification again.

mc48e3134e11a.en: This older offline identity is not linked to an ownership account and cannot launch in AMBER. Add a verified offline identity; existing instances and saves are kept.

ma1c672bfc1a8.zh: 将为 {0} 创建离线身份，沿用同一角色 UUID。
ma1c672bfc1a8.en: Create an offline identity for {0}, retaining the same profile UUID.

m6abe4fc56006.zh: 请先添加微软账号并验证资格，再创建离线身份。
m6abe4fc56006.en: Add a Microsoft account and verify ownership before creating an offline identity.

m8193965a6242.zh: 第三方登录只验证该服务器的身份，不证明游戏所有权。保存后请关联微软资格账号。
m8193965a6242.en: Third-party sign-in verifies your server identity, not game ownership. After saving, link a Microsoft ownership account.

m3d1eb77e0558.zh: 启动授权无效或已过期，请重新点击启动。
m3d1eb77e0558.en: Launch authorization is invalid or expired. Click Launch again.

m2be1c4225483.zh: AmberE 不提供微软登录，请使用离线或第三方账号。
m2be1c4225483.en: AmberE does not provide Microsoft sign-in. Use an offline or third-party account.

m6e149fcf6086.zh: 请先到账号页验证 Minecraft Java 版正版资格。离线资格有效期为 7 天。
m6e149fcf6086.en: Verify Minecraft Java Edition ownership on the Accounts page first. Offline verification is valid for 7 days.

m46b187d34937.zh: 请先选择第三方账号及用于验证资格的微软账号。
m46b187d34937.en: Select a third-party account and a Microsoft ownership account first.

m8a77a859e13b.zh: 离线账号与正版身份不一致，请在账号页重新创建已验证离线身份。
m8a77a859e13b.en: The offline and official profiles do not match. Create a new verified offline identity on the Accounts page.

m475c487f388c.en: This account type is not supported.

md613fb6fea2f.zh: 第三方账号尚未关联正版资格，请前往账号页关联并验证。
md613fb6fea2f.en: This third-party account has no linked ownership verification. Link and verify it on the Accounts page.

m4d9919f41efc.zh: AMBER 启动完整游戏前必须验证正版资格，请前往账号页登录。
m4d9919f41efc.en: AMBER requires verified ownership before launching the full game. Sign in on the Accounts page.

m2fe406be75cc.zh: 账号已移除或角色已改变，请重新选择账号。
m2fe406be75cc.en: The account was removed or its profile changed. Select the account again.

m184609728077.zh: 正版资格已改变，请重新点击启动。
m184609728077.en: Ownership verification changed. Click Launch again.

mbd27862e0487.zh: 账号或游戏资格需要处理
mbd27862e0487.en: Account or game ownership needs attention

m2e261550a24e.zh: 前往账号页登录、重新验证或关联正版资格。认证失败不会自动切换为离线模式。
m2e261550a24e.en: Open Accounts to sign in, verify ownership again, or link an ownership account. Authentication failure never switches automatically to offline mode.

guide.intro.zh: 选择适合你的创建方式。原有手动配置保持可用。
guide.intro.en: Choose how to create an instance. Manual configuration remains available.

guide.guidedDesc.zh: 告诉我们你想怎么玩，检查并选择一套配置。
guide.guidedDesc.en: Tell us how you play, then review a suggested setup.

guide.manualDesc.zh: 自己选择 Minecraft、加载器和组件。
guide.manualDesc.en: Choose Minecraft, a loader and components yourself.

guide.packDesc.zh: 按服务器或整合包的清单创建，不额外拼装模组。
guide.packDesc.en: Follow a modpack or server manifest without adding unrelated mods.

guide.manualNote.zh: 问卷已保留；手动创建需要重新选择版本与组件。
guide.manualNote.en: Your answers are saved; choose versions and components in manual creation.

guide.working.zh: 正在核对版本、加载器和依赖…

guide.checking.zh: 正在重新检查整个方案…

guide.metadata.zh: 已检查声明的兼容性，尚未实测游戏运行。
guide.metadata.en: Declared compatibility checked; gameplay has not been tested.

guide.sources.zh: 推荐目录＋平台实时文件信息；不保证帧率。
guide.sources.en: Curated suggestions and current file metadata; no FPS guarantee.

guide.reasonPerformance.zh: 改善客户端渲染效率；效果取决于硬件与场景。
guide.reasonPerformance.en: Improves client rendering efficiency; results depend on hardware and scene.

guide.reasonLogic.zh: 优化游戏逻辑，不主动扩展玩法。
guide.reasonLogic.en: Optimizes game logic without intentionally changing gameplay.

guide.reasonMenu.zh: 提供模组列表与配置入口。
guide.reasonMenu.en: Provides a mod list and configuration entry points.

guide.reasonRecipes.zh: 便于查询配方，适合信息较多的玩法。
guide.reasonRecipes.en: Recipe browsing for more complex gameplay.

guide.reasonBuilding.zh: 为熟悉模组的建筑玩家提供投影辅助。

guide.reasonExploration.zh: 扩展新世界地形，只向单人方案推荐。
guide.reasonExploration.en: Expands world generation; suggested for single-player setups only.

guide.reasonShaderSupport.zh: 为光影提供 Iris 支持。

guide.reasonShader.zh: 符合画面偏好；下载后需在游戏内启用并选择性能档位。
guide.reasonShader.en: Matches visual preferences; enable in game and choose a performance preset.

guide.reasonSimpleTexture.zh: 提供较简洁的材质风格。

guide.reasonFaithfulTexture.zh: 保留原版风格的较高分辨率材质。
guide.reasonFaithfulTexture.en: Higher-resolution textures retaining the vanilla style.

guide.reasonRequired.en: An item you marked as required.

guide.required.zh: 作者声明必要 · 默认选中

guide.optional.zh: 可选依赖 · 按需选择

guide.ack.zh: 我知道取消必要依赖可能导致游戏无法启动
guide.ack.en: I understand that skipping required dependencies may prevent the game from starting

guide.unchecked.zh: 存在未满足的必要依赖：可恢复勾选或移除依赖它的模组。
guide.unchecked.en: Required dependencies were skipped: restore them or remove the mod that needs them.

guide.estimate.zh: 下载量仅包含所选内容；游戏和 Java 另行下载。空间为保守估算，并非精确需求。
guide.estimate.en: Download size covers selected content only; game and Java downloads are additional. Space is a conservative estimate, not an exact requirement.

guide.visualNote.zh: 光影和材质包安装后仅代表已下载。请在游戏的光影／资源包菜单启用；启动器不会改动游戏画质设置。
guide.visualNote.en: Installed shaders and resource packs are downloaded only. Enable them in the game menus; the launcher does not change graphics settings.

guide.hardwareNote.zh: 配置仅在本地处理。请按实际运行游戏的显卡填写；检测到独显不代表游戏一定使用它。未知硬件采用保守建议，不保证帧率。
guide.hardwareNote.en: Hardware stays local. Select the GPU actually used by the game; detecting a dedicated GPU does not prove the game uses it. Unknown hardware receives conservative suggestions, with no FPS guarantee.

guide.ram.zh: 总内存（GB；0 为自动检测）

guide.serverLoaderVersion.zh: 加载器指定版本（可留空）

guide.serverHelp.zh: 不知道要求时，请先询问服主。这里不会扫描服务器，也不能保证服务器允许所有客户端模组。
guide.serverHelp.en: Ask the server owner if unsure. This does not scan servers or guarantee client mods are allowed.

guide.questionContent.zh: 最想体验什么？（最多三项）

guide.questionExperience.en: How familiar are you with mods?

guide.rich.zh: 信息丰富 · 配方等辅助

guide.downloadLimitLabel.en: Content download limit (GB; 0 means no limit)

guide.diskLimitLabel.zh: 可用空间预算（GB；0 为检测值）
guide.diskLimitLabel.en: Disk budget (GB; 0 uses detected free space)

guide.power.zh: 优先节能，不自动推荐光影
guide.power.en: Prefer power saving; do not suggest shaders

guide.serverRules.zh: 多人方案仍需遵守服务器模组规则；不会安装声明为服务端必需的玩法扩展。
guide.serverRules.en: Follow server mod rules. Gameplay additions requiring server installation are excluded.

guide.serverUnknown.zh: 服务器版本未知：请与服主核对后再安装。
guide.serverUnknown.en: Server version is unknown: confirm with the owner before installing.

guide.serverLoaderUnknown.zh: 服务器加载器未知：此方案只是客户端建议，不能替代服务器清单。
guide.serverLoaderUnknown.en: Server loader is unknown: this client suggestion does not replace the server manifest.

guide.visualConservative.zh: 根据未知或受限的硬件配置，未自动加入光影或高清材质。
guide.visualConservative.en: Shaders or high-resolution textures were not added because hardware is unknown or limited.

guide.someUnavailable.zh: 部分推荐项目或平台信息暂不可用。当前清单只包含成功核对的内容。
guide.someUnavailable.en: Some suggestions or metadata were unavailable. This list contains only items that could be checked.

guide.packSuggested.zh: 复杂科技、魔法或战斗玩法建议使用维护完整的整合包；当前方案仅提供基础辅助。
guide.packSuggested.en: For complex technology, magic or combat, use a maintained modpack. This setup provides basic assistance only.

guide.incomplete.zh: 安装未完成，已保留实例

guide.doneNote.zh: 游戏文件已准备完成。账号是否可启动仍按当前版本的认证规则检查。
guide.doneNote.en: Game files are ready. Launch eligibility is still checked under this edition’s account rules.

guide.savedPlanNote.zh: 这是创建时的固定清单；之后在内容管理中的修改不自动改写此记录。
guide.savedPlanNote.en: This is the pinned creation plan; later content-management edits do not rewrite it.

guide.skipVisuals.zh: 跳过剩余光影与材质，完成安装
guide.skipVisuals.en: Skip remaining visual packs and finish

guide.skipped.zh: 已明确跳过视觉资源；已经安装的文件保留。
guide.skipped.en: Visual packs were explicitly skipped; files already installed are retained.

guide.duplicateVersion.zh: 同一模组要求两个不同版本，请移除冲突项目。
guide.duplicateVersion.en: A mod requires two different versions. Remove a conflicting item.

guide.duplicatePath.zh: 两个内容文件的路径重复，请移除其中一个。
guide.duplicatePath.en: Two content files use the same path. Remove one.

guide.declaredConflict.zh: 所选项目声明互不兼容，请移除其中一个。
guide.declaredConflict.en: Selected projects declare an incompatibility. Remove one.

guide.missingDependency.zh: 缺少必要依赖，请恢复勾选或移除依赖它的模组。
guide.missingDependency.en: A required dependency is missing. Restore it or remove its consumer.

guide.shaderSupportMissing.zh: 光影缺少 Iris 支持，请同时保留 Iris 或移除光影。
guide.shaderSupportMissing.en: Shaders need Iris. Keep Iris or remove the shader pack.

guide.downloadLimit.zh: 所选内容超过下载预算，请提高预算或减少内容。
guide.downloadLimit.en: Selected content exceeds the download budget. Raise it or remove content.

guide.diskLimit.zh: 预留空间不足，请释放磁盘、提高空间预算或减少内容。
guide.diskLimit.en: Insufficient reserved space. Free disk space, raise the budget or remove content.

guide.expired.zh: 推荐已过期，请重新生成并检查方案。
guide.expired.en: The suggestion expired. Generate and review a new setup.

guide.invalidSelection.zh: 内容选择无效，必装内容需先在问卷中修改。
guide.invalidSelection.en: Invalid selection. Change required items in the questionnaire first.

guide.unknownServerVersion.zh: 官方目录没有此服务器版本，请核对版本号。
guide.unknownServerVersion.en: The server version is not in the official catalog. Check its spelling.

guide.loaderRequired.zh: 请先指定加载器类型，再填写其版本。
guide.loaderRequired.en: Choose a loader before entering its version.

guide.invalidProject.zh: 所选项目不是可安装的模组、材质或光影。
guide.invalidProject.en: The project is not an installable mod, resource pack or shader.

guide.noCommonVersion.zh: 必装内容与指定版本没有交集，请修改必装项目或服务器要求。
guide.noCommonVersion.en: Required content and version constraints have no common version. Adjust the required items or server requirements.

guide.noPlan.zh: 未找到通过检查的组合。请减少必装项目、检查服务器要求，或改用手动创建。
guide.noPlan.en: No checked combination was found. Reduce required items, check server requirements, or use manual creation.

guide.invalidPlan.zh: 固定安装清单无法读取，请打开实例目录检查，不会自动替换文件。
guide.invalidPlan.en: The pinned plan is invalid. Inspect the instance folder; files will not be silently replaced.

guide.changedFile.zh: 固定文件已下架或兼容信息已改变，暂停安装。请重试或重新创建方案。
guide.changedFile.en: A pinned file is unavailable or its compatibility changed. Installation paused. Retry or create a new plan.

guide.changedTarget.zh: 实例版本或加载器与固定方案不一致，请在实例设置检查。
guide.changedTarget.en: The instance version or loader differs from the pinned plan. Check instance settings.

guide.notCompatible.zh: 兼容检查未通过，请先处理清单中的问题。
guide.notCompatible.en: Compatibility checks failed. Resolve the listed problems first.

guide.acknowledge.zh: 请确认取消必要依赖的风险，或恢复勾选。
guide.acknowledge.en: Acknowledge the skipped-dependency risk or restore the dependencies.

guide.cannotSkip.zh: 此阶段或依赖关系不允许跳过视觉资源。请继续安装或管理实例。
guide.cannotSkip.en: Visual resources cannot be skipped at this stage or with these dependencies. Resume or manage the instance.

guide.draftInvalid.zh: 草稿无法读取。可使用默认答案继续，保存会覆盖损坏草稿。
guide.draftInvalid.en: The draft could not be read. Continue with defaults; saving replaces the damaged draft.

guide.tooMany.zh: 依赖信息过多，请减少所选内容。
guide.tooMany.en: Too much dependency metadata. Select fewer items.

guide.invalidAnswers.zh: 问卷数据无效，请检查填写内容。

guide.packRequirements.zh: 游戏与加载器由整合包清单确定。请与服务器要求核对。
guide.packRequirements.en: The manifest determines the game and loader. Compare them with server requirements.

guide.checkingFailure.zh: 部分检查未能完成，请重试；不会自动安装未经核对的文件。
guide.checkingFailure.en: Some checks could not finish. Retry; unchecked files will not be installed.

guide.weights.zh: 先满足版本与必装要求，再按功能覆盖选择组合。三档均遵守玩法边界与测试版本偏好。
guide.weights.en: Version and required-project constraints come first, then functional coverage. All tiers respect gameplay boundaries and preview preferences.

guide.packFailed.zh: 整合包无法检查，请重新选择或重试。
guide.packFailed.en: The modpack could not be checked. Choose another release or retry.

guide.omitted.zh: 未加入（无兼容文件、停用或受偏好限制）：
guide.omitted.en: Not included (no compatible file, disabled or excluded by preferences):

guide.versionPinned.zh: 版本由你的服务器要求锁定。
guide.versionPinned.en: The version is pinned by your server requirement.

guide.versionRequired.zh: 版本优先满足你指定的必装内容，并核对其客户端发行版。
guide.versionRequired.en: The version prioritizes required projects and their compatible client releases.

guide.versionAvailable.zh: 版本根据稳定性偏好和推荐内容的可用发行版选择。
guide.versionAvailable.en: The version follows stability preferences and available releases of suggested content.

guide.loaderVanilla.en: This setup does not need a loader.

guide.loaderAvailable.zh: 加载器及其版本已与游戏版本和所选内容核对。
guide.loaderAvailable.en: The loader release has been checked against the game version and selected content.

guide.duplicateRenderer.zh: 多个渲染或光影实现功能重叠，请只保留一种。
guide.duplicateRenderer.en: Multiple rendering or shader implementations overlap. Keep only one.

guide.featureQuestion.zh: 功能偏好 · 按需选择，可使用同类替代
guide.featureQuestion.en: Features · choose what you need; equivalents are allowed

guide.gameplayQuestion.zh: 拓展主题 · 仅明确选择后加入

guide.recipePreference.zh: 合成查询偏好（允许兼容替代）

guide.memoryHelp.zh: 降低内存占用，实际效果随模组和场景变化。
guide.memoryHelp.en: Reduces memory usage; results vary with mods and scenes.

guide.cullingHelp.zh: 减少被遮挡实体的渲染开销。

guide.immediateHelp.zh: 优化实体、界面等即时渲染路径。
guide.immediateHelp.en: Optimizes immediate rendering such as entities and UI.

guide.backgroundHelp.zh: 降低后台、闲置时的资源消耗，不代表前台帧率提升。
guide.backgroundHelp.en: Reduces background and idle usage, not a promise of higher foreground FPS.

guide.identifyHelp.zh: 显示所看方块与实体的信息；部分数据需要服务端支持。
guide.identifyHelp.en: Shows targeted block/entity information; some data needs server support.

guide.foodHelp.zh: 显示食物信息；准确饱和度等需要服务端支持。
guide.foodHelp.en: Displays food information; exact saturation needs server support.

guide.inventoryHelp.zh: 增加拖动、滚轮等背包操作。
guide.inventoryHelp.en: Adds inventory drag and scroll controls.

guide.minimapHelp.zh: 提供小地图和路径点；多人使用前请确认服务器规则。
guide.minimapHelp.en: Provides a minimap and waypoints; confirm server rules.

guide.worldmapHelp.zh: 记录探索过的世界；与小地图分开选择。
guide.worldmapHelp.en: Maps explored terrain; selected separately from the minimap.

guide.connectedHelp.zh: 提供连接材质支持。进游戏后启用自带资源包。
guide.connectedHelp.en: Provides connected textures. Enable the included resource packs in game.

guide.skinsHelp.zh: 将皮肤外层显示为立体效果，不改变账号认证。
guide.skinsHelp.en: Renders outer skin layers in 3D; does not change authentication.

guide.farmingHelp.zh: 增加烹饪、作物和物品；只在选择拓展主题时加入。
guide.farmingHelp.en: Adds cooking, crops and items only when this theme is selected.

guide.decorationHelp.zh: 增加装饰和功能方块，会改变原版内容。
guide.decorationHelp.en: Adds decorative and functional blocks, changing vanilla content.

guide.machineryHelp.zh: 增加机械自动化，学习和资源成本较高。
guide.machineryHelp.en: Adds mechanical automation with greater learning and resource costs.

guide.lodHelp.zh: 远距离地形显示；需要额外显卡、内存和缓存空间。
guide.lodHelp.en: Distant terrain rendering needs additional GPU, memory and cache resources.

guide.resolutionQuestion.zh: 游戏分辨率与流畅度目标

guide.fps.zh: 流畅度目标（非保证帧率）

guide.opengl46.zh: 确认游戏使用的显卡与驱动支持 OpenGL 4.6（Voxy）
guide.opengl46.en: I confirmed the game GPU and driver support OpenGL 4.6 (Voxy)

guide.noCompatibleFeature.zh: 文件、依赖或已选内容未能组成兼容方案。
guide.noCompatibleFeature.en: Files, dependencies or existing choices could not form a compatible combination.

guide.disabledKept.zh: 已有同类内容被停用，保留你的选择。
guide.disabledKept.en: Existing equivalent content is disabled; your choice is preserved.

guide.substitutionReason.zh: 优先项的文件或依赖不适配此组合，改用同类功能。
guide.substitutionReason.en: The preferred file or its dependencies do not fit this setup; an equivalent was selected.

guide.partialServer.zh: Jade / AppleSkin 的部分信息需要服务端支持；仅客户端安装不保证全部功能。
guide.partialServer.en: Some Jade / AppleSkin information needs server support; client installation does not enable every feature.

guide.lodUnavailable.zh: 当前版本、测试版本偏好或显卡信息未满足远景组合要求，已保留无远景方案。可调整远景或测试版本选项后重试。
guide.lodUnavailable.en: The version, preview preference or GPU information does not meet the distant-terrain requirements. This setup omits LOD. Adjust those options and try again.

guide.shaderUnavailable.zh: 未找到经过文件级核验的光影组合，已保留无光影方案。
guide.shaderUnavailable.en: No file-verified shader combination was found; shaders are omitted.

guide.visualUnverified.zh: 光影、Iris 与远景的具体文件组合不在核验目录内。请恢复推荐组合或移除光影。
guide.visualUnverified.en: The exact shader, Iris and LOD files are not in the verified directory. Restore the recommended combination or remove shaders.

guide.visualSettingsExist.zh: 已有不同的光影配置，未覆盖。请在实例目录检查配置，或从任务中心跳过视觉配置。
guide.visualSettingsExist.en: Different shader settings already exist and were preserved. Inspect the instance folder or skip visual configuration in the task center.

guide.visualEvidence.zh: 作者集成代码与文件版本已核对；未实测该电脑的游戏表现。
guide.visualEvidence.en: Author integration code and file versions checked; gameplay on this computer has not been tested.

guide.visualConfigured.zh: 已为新实例写入光影预设和 Iris 启用设置。资源包仍需在游戏内选择。
guide.visualConfigured.en: Shader preset and Iris enable settings written for this new instance. Select resource packs in game.

guide.visualPending.zh: 新实例安装后会写入所示光影预设。若已有不同配置，将保留并提示处理。
guide.visualPending.en: The shown shader preset will be written after installation. Different existing settings will be preserved for review.

guide.addonTitle.zh: 为现有实例补装推荐功能

guide.addonIntro.zh: 固定当前游戏和加载器，仅补充客户端功能。保留现有版本、停用状态、配置与存档；不自动替换或移除内容。
guide.addonIntro.en: Keep this game and loader and add client features. Existing versions, disabled states, settings and worlds are preserved; no automatic replacements or removals.

guide.addonChanged.zh: 实例内容已变化、被停用或缺失。请到内容管理检查，再重新生成方案；未覆盖文件。
guide.addonChanged.en: Content changed, is disabled or missing. Review content management and generate again; no files were overwritten.

guide.addonNotReady.zh: 请先完成此实例的安装任务并关闭游戏，再补装功能。
guide.addonNotReady.en: Finish this instance’s pending tasks and close the game before adding features.

guide.addonUnmanaged.zh: 发现启用的未识别本地模组。请在内容管理识别这些文件或先停用，再生成推荐，以免重复安装同类功能。
guide.addonUnmanaged.en: Enabled unidentified local mods were found. Identify or disable them in content management before generating recommendations to avoid duplicate features.

guide.addonVisualManual.zh: 补装仅增加客户端功能，不改动现有光影配置或加入玩法内容。远景和光影请在内容管理中单独配置。
guide.addonVisualManual.en: Additions only add client features. Existing shaders and gameplay are preserved; configure LOD and shaders separately in content management.

guide.nothingToAdd.zh: 所选功能已经满足，没有需要补装的文件。
guide.nothingToAdd.en: Selected features are already present; no files need adding.

guide.rollbackHelp.zh: 补装可在模组管理的变更历史中恢复；恢复只涉及内容文件，不回退存档。
guide.rollbackHelp.en: Undo additions in content-management history. Recovery concerns content files, not worlds.

guide.tierSame.zh: 这些档位内容相同：当前偏好或兼容范围不需要额外内容。
guide.tierSame.en: These tiers contain the same content; your preferences or compatibility limits do not require extra items.

guide.tierDifferent.zh: 此档位使用不同的游戏版本或加载器，请核对后选择。
guide.tierDifferent.en: This tier uses a different game version or loader. Review before selecting.

guide.tipsRecipes.zh: 合成查询：通常在物品上按 R 查看配方、U 查看用途；以模组实际按键设置为准。
guide.tipsRecipes.en: Recipe viewer: usually R for recipes and U for uses over an item; check the mod’s key bindings.

guide.tipsMap.zh: 地图：请在游戏按键设置中查看地图入口，服务器是否允许由服主决定。
guide.tipsMap.en: Maps: check game key bindings for map controls; server permission is determined by the owner.

guide.tipsConfig.zh: 模组配置：可使用 Mod Menu（若已安装），或游戏内对应设置入口。
guide.tipsConfig.en: Mod settings: use Mod Menu if installed, or the mod’s own settings entry.

guide.tipsVisual.zh: 若画面不流畅，可在光影选项降低预设或关闭光影；远景缓存会额外占用磁盘。
guide.tipsVisual.en: If performance is poor, lower the shader preset or disable shaders. LOD caches use additional disk space.

guide.autoChecking.zh: 选择改变后自动重新检查；完成前不能安装。
guide.autoChecking.en: Changes are rechecked automatically. Installation waits for the check.

guide.gpuBudget.zh: 实际游戏显卡的性能档位（不确定时保守配置）
guide.gpuBudget.en: Actual game GPU capability (conservative when unknown)

guide.gpuBudget_unknown.zh: 不确定 · 极低光影预设

guide.restoreSuggestions.zh: 恢复已移除的推荐功能

guide.addonEstimate.zh: 下载和空间仅计算新增文件；不修改此实例的内存、光影或其他游戏配置。
guide.addonEstimate.en: Download and space estimates cover new files only. Instance memory, shaders and game settings are preserved.

guide.addonVersion.zh: 游戏版本与加载器由当前实例锁定。
guide.addonVersion.en: Game and loader versions are locked to this instance.

guide.invalidDraft.zh: 草稿格式无效，当前输入已保留。请重试保存。
guide.invalidDraft.en: The draft is invalid. Your current input is retained. Retry saving.

guide.templateLimit.zh: 最多保存 20 份本地模板，请先删除不需要的模板。
guide.templateLimit.en: Up to 20 local templates are supported. Remove an unused template first.

guide.templateDuplicate.zh: 已有同名模板，请使用其他名称。
guide.templateDuplicate.en: A template with this name already exists. Choose another name.

guide.generationBusy.zh: 上一轮检查尚在结束，请稍候重试。
guide.generationBusy.en: The previous check is still finishing. Retry shortly.

guide.generationCancelled.zh: 已取消生成，填写内容已保留。
guide.generationCancelled.en: Generation cancelled. Your answers are retained.

guide.generationLimited.zh: 内容服务暂时限流。填写内容已保留，请稍后重新生成。
guide.generationLimited.en: The content service is rate-limited. Your answers are retained. Retry later.

guide.generationNetwork.zh: 未能完整读取兼容信息，不能据此判断模组不兼容。请检查网络后重试。
guide.generationNetwork.en: Compatibility information could not be fully retrieved. This does not mean the mods are incompatible. Check the connection and retry.

guide.phase_versions.zh: 正在读取游戏版本与环境…

guide.phase_matching.zh: 正在匹配功能与模组版本…

guide.phase_visuals.zh: 正在核对光影与远景组合…

guide.editFullList.en: Edit the full list and dependencies

guide.restoreDraft.zh: 已恢复上次选择。生成方案后会重新核验兼容性。
guide.restoreDraft.en: Previous choices restored. Generating a setup will recheck compatibility.

guide.refreshPlan.zh: 保留选择，重新核验方案

guide.expiredPlan.zh: 方案已过期。已保留填写内容，请重新核验后确认变化。
guide.expiredPlan.en: This setup expired. Your input is retained. Recheck it and review the changes.

guide.refreshChoices.zh: 已尝试保留依赖选择；不同文件版本的依赖需要重新确认。
guide.refreshChoices.en: Dependency choices were retained where possible. Dependencies of different file versions need a new review.

guide.profileChanged.zh: 游戏版本或加载器与刚才不同，请检查后再安装。
guide.profileChanged.en: The game version or loader differs from your previous choice. Review before installing.

guide.templateNote.zh: 仅保存需求与偏好，不保存账号、路径或旧安装文件。使用时重新匹配兼容版本；补装仍受当前实例限制。
guide.templateNote.en: Stores preferences only, without accounts, paths or old installation files. Compatibility is checked again on use; additions remain constrained by the current instance.

guide.templateDeleteQuestion.zh: 删除这份本地模板？不会删除实例或存档。
guide.templateDeleteQuestion.en: Delete this local template? Instances and worlds are unaffected.

guide.templateSave.zh: 将当前偏好保存为模板

guide.templateApplied.zh: 已应用模板。请检查偏好，再生成推荐。
guide.templateApplied.en: Template applied. Review preferences before generating a setup.

guide.tierDifferences.zh: 当前档位与其他档位的差异

guide.noUniqueFeatures.zh: 此档位没有额外的独有内容；请结合玩法改动和资源负担选择。
guide.noUniqueFeatures.en: This tier has no additional unique content. Compare gameplay changes and resource load.

guide.refreshReview.zh: 以下内容已变化，请重新确认。不会自动安装。
guide.refreshReview.en: The following content changed. Review it again; installation is not automatic.

guide.conflictGroup.zh: 冲突与需要处理的问题

guide.noConflicts.zh: 未发现已声明的冲突；仍需实际游戏验证。
guide.noConflicts.en: No declared conflicts found; actual gameplay still needs validation.

guide.aftercareNote.zh: 这是配置说明，不代表已实测游戏运行。修改画面设置后请在游戏中确认效果。
guide.aftercareNote.en: This is configuration guidance, not gameplay verification. Confirm visual changes in game.

guide.aftercareMods.zh: 在内容管理中查看本次安装的模组；有模组菜单时，可在游戏内查找配置入口。
guide.aftercareMods.en: Review installed mods in content management. If a mod menu is present, look for configuration entries in game.

guide.aftercareVisualExisting.zh: 保留原有光影配置，请在游戏内确认启用状态
guide.aftercareVisualExisting.en: Existing shader settings are preserved. Check their enabled state in game

guide.aftercareVisualCheck.zh: 在游戏的视频／光影设置中确认所选光影与预设
guide.aftercareVisualCheck.en: Confirm the selected shader and preset in the game video/shader settings

guide.aftercareResources.zh: 资源包需要在游戏的“资源包”设置中启用，下载完成不等于已经启用。
guide.aftercareResources.en: Enable resource packs in the game Resource Packs settings; a download does not enable them.

guide.aftercareDH.zh: Distant Horizons：在模组设置中检查远景距离。首次生成远景可能占用较多处理器和磁盘资源，可先从较低距离开始。
guide.aftercareDH.en: Distant Horizons: check distant-terrain distance in its settings. Initial generation can use substantial CPU and disk resources; start with a shorter distance.

guide.aftercareVoxy.zh: Voxy：在模组设置中检查远景与光影状态。若出现异常，先停用远景进行排查，保留存档与原有配置。
guide.aftercareVoxy.en: Voxy: check distant-terrain and shader settings. If problems appear, disable distant terrain first for diagnosis, preserving worlds and configuration.

bench.copying.zh: 正在复制并校验试用副本

bench.pending.zh: 请先完成安装，再进行试用或恢复。
bench.pending.en: Finish installation before using trials or recovery.

bench.tooMany.zh: 文件数量超过限制，请先整理实例。
bench.tooMany.en: Too many files. Please organize the instance first.

bench.invalid.zh: 记录或文件未通过校验，操作已停止。
bench.invalid.en: The record or file failed validation. The operation stopped.

bench.externalBlock.zh: 文件已发生变化。已停止覆盖，请刷新记录并检查文件。
bench.externalBlock.en: Files changed. Overwriting stopped. Refresh the records and inspect the files.

bench.sourceChanged.zh: 原实例已经改变，无法直接回写。请保留试用副本，或从原实例重新创建试用。
bench.sourceChanged.en: The original instance changed. Keep this trial or create a new one from the original.

bench.targetChanged.zh: 游戏或加载器已经改变，不能直接回写。请保留为独立实例。
bench.targetChanged.en: The game or loader changed. Keep this as an independent instance.

bench.expired.zh: 预览已过期，请重新检查变化。
bench.expired.en: The preview expired. Review the changes again.

bench.contentTogether.zh: 模组、资源包、光影及其清单需要作为一组应用。配置可以单独选择。
bench.contentTogether.en: Apply mods, resources, shaders and their manifest as a group. Configuration files can be selected separately.

bench.restoreNote.zh: 仅恢复记录中的模组、资源包、光影及配置。不修改存档。若文件发生变化将停止覆盖。
bench.restoreNote.en: Restore only recorded mods, resources, shaders and configuration. Worlds are untouched. Changed files block overwriting.

bench.noRestore.zh: 没有可直接恢复的备份，或文件已经改变
bench.noRestore.en: No directly restorable backup, or files changed

bench.markGood.zh: 我已游玩，确认运行正常
bench.markGood.en: I played and confirmed it works

bench.goodNote.zh: 此标记由你确认，不代表启动器已完成游戏兼容性测试。
bench.goodNote.en: This is your confirmation, not automated gameplay compatibility testing.

bench.emptyHistory.zh: 尚无文件变化。下一次内容操作会在此留下记录。
bench.emptyHistory.en: No file changes yet. Your next content operation will appear here.

bench.trialNote.zh: 试用副本使用独立文件，不共享可写存档。模组与配置的回写需要再次预览；不会合并世界进度。
bench.trialNote.en: Trials use independent files and worlds. Applying content and configuration requires a fresh review; world progress is never merged.

bench.apply.en: Back up and apply selected changes

bench.configNote.zh: 配置按整个文件替换，不自动合并。账号选择和存档不会回写。
bench.configNote.en: Configuration replaces whole files; no automatic merge. Account selection and worlds are excluded.

bench.memoryEvidence.zh: 日志出现内存不足的明确提示。检查分配内存及近期新增的内容。
bench.memoryEvidence.en: The log reports insufficient memory. Review memory allocation and recent additions.

bench.javaEvidence.zh: 日志出现 Java 字节码版本不匹配。请检查所选 Java。
bench.javaEvidence.en: The log reports a Java bytecode mismatch. Check the selected Java runtime.

bench.modEvidence.zh: 日志报告模组解析或依赖问题。请查看完整错误及相关模组。
bench.modEvidence.en: The log reports mod resolution or dependency problems. Review the complete error and related mods.

bench.graphicsEvidence.zh: 日志报告图形上下文或 OpenGL 初始化问题。请检查驱动与渲染配置。
bench.graphicsEvidence.en: The log reports graphics context or OpenGL initialization problems. Check drivers and renderer settings.

bench.unknown.zh: 暂未发现可明确归类的日志证据。最近修改仅是排查线索，不代表崩溃原因。
bench.unknown.en: No conclusive category found in the log. Recent changes are clues, not proven crash causes.

bench.searchHint.zh: 输入实例、内存、备份或光影…
bench.searchHint.en: Search instances, memory, backups or shaders…

bench.noResults.zh: 没有匹配的实例或操作

bench.templateFormat.zh: 模板格式无效或包含不支持的字段。
bench.templateFormat.en: The template format is invalid or contains unsupported fields.

bench.templateImportNote.zh: 仅导入问卷偏好。不会安装内容，应用后需要重新生成并检查方案。
bench.templateImportNote.en: Import questionnaire preferences only. Nothing is installed; regenerate and review a plan after applying it.

bench.noKnownIssues.en: No known problems found by the check; gameplay still needs confirmation.
